title: Docker image build fails - wget cannot resolve raw.githubusercontent.com (DNS failure)

failed_jobs.name: Docker
failed_jobs.symptom: Image build for ubuntu_22_04_x64_igpu failed during 'RUN wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/gtest-parallel/master/gtest_parallel.py' step with DNS resolution failure.

RuntimeError: Command 'docker buildx build ... --file .github/dockerfiles/ov_test/ubuntu_22_04_x64_igpu/Dockerfile ...' returned non-zero exit status 1
root_cause: The 'Docker' job builds the ubuntu_22_04_x64_igpu test image. During the Dockerfile RUN step that downloads gtest_parallel.py from raw.githubusercontent.com via wget, DNS resolution for raw.githubusercontent.com failed inside the Docker build container ('Temporary failure in name resolution'). This is a transient network/DNS outage inside the build container/runner network, not caused by the PR's sccache version bump (which only touches Dockerfile build-arg/ENV lines for sccache, unrelated to this wget step or network setup). The PR's changed files do not modify networking, DNS, or the gtest_parallel.py download step.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reliably reproducible locally; requires hitting the same transient DNS outage. Re-running the failed 'Docker' job alone is expected to succeed once DNS resolves normally.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'Docker' job (no code change needed); the workflow rerunner already covers this via 'unable to resolve host' / 'Temporary failure in name resolution' entries in errors_to_look_for.json.

If this recurs frequently, consider mirroring gtest_parallel.py into the internal Azure Container Registry/artifact cache instead of fetching it live from raw.githubusercontent.com during image builds.
Monitor runner/network health for aks-linux-4-cores-16gb-docker-build if DNS failures become frequent.
prevention_strategies: Avoid depending on live external downloads (wget/curl to GitHub raw content) inside Dockerfile RUN steps for CI-critical images; vendor or cache such scripts in the registry so a transient DNS/network blip does not fail the whole merge-queue run.
historical_context: No prior pattern record for this exact DNS-resolution signature (raw.githubusercontent.com wget failure during Docker image build) was found in repo-memory. A related but distinct pattern (signature_hash 966a1b79fea18174) recorded a Docker buildx builder boot failure (BuildKit image not found in ACR) on 2026-07-15, which is a different root cause (builder provisioning vs. in-container DNS resolution).
